dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible in the anterior-dorsal region. The most prominent three features exhibit sharp, high-contrast dark perimeters approximately 5-10 pixels wide that transition abruptly to high-intensity, lighter centers. These structures vary from near-perfect circularity to slightly elongated ellipses.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid, high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients. These are primarily concentrated along the lower-lateral margin and between the larger macro-annuli, appearing as isolated, irregular points of high-reflectance pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent macro-annuli in the anterior region form a non-equilateral quadrilateral. Connecting these centroids with the three nearest high-intensity blobs creates a series of interlocking triangular geometric relationships across the lateral field.
